environment.description: Exact launch-environment names this artifact asks the executable trust gate to approve; spawn hook output must be a subset.

oneOf.title: host command requirement
oneOf.description: A command that must be present on PATH before the capability can work.

oneOf.title: runtime package requirement
oneOf.description: A package that must be installed into a specific runtime's own package manager. Raised only for deployments using that runtime, satisfied by the runtime's package list rather than by PATH, and installed only with explicit consent.

package.description: Source spec in that runtime's own naming: "npm:@scope/name" for pi, "plugin@marketplace" for Claude.

install.description: Documentation URL shown alongside the consent prompt.

marketplace.description: Optional source to register before installing (Claude marketplaces). Shown at the consent prompt, since registering a third-party source is part of what is being agreed to.

when.description: Applies only when every named capability setting has the given effective value (a requirement conditional on configuration, e.g. delivery: channel).

minVersion.description: Lowest acceptable installed version of the package, read from the package.json under the install directory the runtime's listing names; an older or absent manifest fails the requirement with the install remedy.

ifInstalled.description: When true, an absent package satisfies the row; the row's minVersion and loadability checks apply only to a package that is installed (an ambient extension that must honour a contract if present).

required.description: Only the spawn hook may be required — retire and soul-scaffold run outside a spawn transaction.
When true, a failure fails the spawn and rolls it back.
Only the spawn hook may be required — retire and soul-scaffold run outside a spawn transaction.

agents.description: Package-relative soul directories (soul.yaml + AGENTS.md) — capability-defined agents; they resolve like local souls where the capability is active, souls stay read-only in the package, instances home under the scope's local-agents/.

settings.description: Declared capability settings: name to { default, values?, description }. Documentation for `oats use --settings`; undeclared settings are still accepted.

values.description: Accepted scalar values; an effective value outside the list is refused at resolution.

environmentNamespaces.description: Additional environment-name prefixes this capability may declare besides its vendor's own (e.g. AWEB_ for the official oats.aweb integration). Each is an uppercase prefix ending in an underscore; the reserved core (OATS_, PI_AGENT_) and process bootstrap namespaces cannot be claimed. Disclosed at trust time with the environment list.
